newsitem.title: UK: UK'S AIRTOURS SAYS CURRENT BOOKINGS AHEAD.
newsitem.headline: UK'S AIRTOURS SAYS CURRENT BOOKINGS AHEAD.

text.p: British tours and travels operator Airtours Plc said on Wednesday that its summer bookings for UK in the current year was 19 percent ahead of the previous year.
The group said its winter prices for 1997/98 was 25 percent ahead of last year.
"Due to strong demand late booking prices are significantly higher than last year thereby reducing the difference between the brochure and non-brochure price," the company said.
In Scandinavia, the sale of holidays for summer 1997 was 11 percent ahead of last year while bookings for winter 1997/98 were up 52 percent.
"Prospects for the remainder of the current year are encouraging with strong demand continuing in the group's main markets," the group added.
Its share price closed at 12.29 stg on Tuesday.
